title: FGC 104: Duties and Powers of the Commissioner of Buildings
officialText:
104.1 General.

The commissioner shall have the authority to render interpretations of this code, adopt rules, and establish policies and procedures in order to clarify and implement its provisions. Such interpretations, policies, procedures, and rules shall be in compliance with the intent and purpose of this code. See the New York City Charter and Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code for additional provisions relating to the authority of the commissioner.
